title: A seeded library that imports random functions by name
proves: every public random function a library imports by name draws from the run's seeded stream
triangular, betavariate, expovariate, gammavariate, lognormvariate, normalvariate, paretovariate, vonmisesvariate and weibullvariate replay identically, also under an alias
Random() without a seed, random.seed() without a value and getstate/setstate replay identically
a Random subclass that the library defines while it loads is not seeded, and the Build replay rejects it
